  "overall_experience": "This CEO from the construction industry likely experienced Smartsheet as a powerful tool for structuring project management and team collaboration, a clear upgrade from Microsoft Excel. While appreciating its ability to centralize workflows and provide a single source of truth, the initial setup and learning curve proved challenging. The product delivered on core functionality for managing projects, but some limitations in customization and the perceived value for money, especially for a smaller team, tempered their overall satisfaction."
